question: When the cross-task H3 rank-two operational subspace is translated through exact model weights, does it recover the known upstream writer and expose concrete downstream read/write interfaces better than the pooled rank-one axis?

frozen_design.head_read_map: For H3 basis Q in raw 128-dimensional value/output coordinates, compute R = Q^T W_V[H3], the exact residual-to-subspace value read map.
frozen_design.head_write_map: Compute O = W_O[:,H3] Q and its orthonormal residual image, the exact subspace-to-residual write interface.
frozen_design.upstream_atlas: Contract every attention-head output and every MLP output in layers 0-10 into R. Rank normalized Frobenius incidence; block8H1 is frozen as the external causal positive control.
frozen_design.downstream_atlas: For layers 12-17, contract the residual write image through every attention q/k/v read and MLP input factor. Report complete rankings and the known L15H1/H5 and MLP17 causal-response controls.
frozen_design.comparison: Repeat gauge-invariant scores for pooled aligned rank one versus task-union rank two; no activation outcomes, fitting, or selection.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_shapes_gauge_and_: Authorities hold; bases are orthonormal; exact read/write shapes hold; random orthogonal gauge changes scores by <=1e-5; price is exactly zero model forwards.
predictions.pred_b_known_writer_is_weight_enriched: Block8H1 ranks in the top quartile of all upstream attention heads under the rank-two H3 read map.
predictions.pred_c_rank2_strengthens_writer_interfac: Capacity-normalized block8H1 incidence into rank two is strictly larger than into pooled aligned rank one.
predictions.pred_d_known_late_attention_readers_are_: Both L15H1 and L15H5 rank in the top half of downstream attention heads by their maximum q/k/v read of the H3 residual write image.
predictions.pred_e_complete_weight_interface_is_repr: All exact matrices receive byte hashes, all rankings cover their frozen inventories without duplicates, and every score is finite.

decision: screen if all predictions pass; partial if A,B,D,E pass but rank two does not strengthen the known writer; null if valid weights fail to recover known causal components; invalid if A or E fails. Weight incidence remains structural evidence and must be paired with the existing causal authorities.
